items.text: Top careers for the future are usually not random trendy job titles.
The stronger paths usually sit where AI adoption, cybersecurity risk, healthcare complexity, electrification, and business-system pressure are creating real demand.
The strongest future-career bets cluster around five demand drivers: AI adoption, cyber risk, ageing-population health demand, the energy transition, and rising business complexity.
